units.source_text: 虽说是别馆，却是在同一个院落里的独间，距本馆约百来米远。

en.t: Although it was called an annex, it was a detached room within the same grounds, about a hundred meters from the main building.

units.source_text: 名人从这条路回去吃午饭，他那背影偶尔落在我的眼帘里。

en.t: The Master would go back along this road to have lunch, and now and then his figure from behind came into my sight.

units.source_text: 走出一号别馆的门，就是斜坡道。

en.t: As soon as one stepped out of the gate of Annex Number One, there was the sloping road.

units.source_text: 名人微弓着腰，独自登了上去。

en.t: The Master, his back slightly bent, climbed it alone.

units.source_text: 他反剪小小的双手，双手轻轻地相握着，看不清手纹，

en.t: He held his small hands clasped behind his back, the two hands lightly folded together, so that the lines of his palms could not be seen,

units.source_text: 不过可以看见细微而杂乱的褶皱，手里还拿着一把合上的折扇。

en.t: but one could see the fine, irregular wrinkles, and he was also holding a closed folding fan in his hand.

units.source_text: 上半身稍微前倾，却是笔直的；相反，下半身飘飘忽忽，脚跟显得不太稳当。

en.t: His upper body leaned slightly forward, yet remained straight; by contrast, his lower body seemed unsteady and drifting, and his heels looked insecure.

units.source_text: 路旁一侧的山白竹下，传来了小溪的流水声。

en.t: From beneath the mountain bamboo on one side of the road came the sound of a little stream flowing.

units.source_text: 仅此而已……不过，面对这位名人的背影，不知怎的，

en.t: That was all there was to it... and yet, as I faced the Master’s back, somehow,

units.source_text: 我的眼睑也发热了，仿佛有什么深切的感受。

en.t: my eyelids too grew warm, as if I were seized by some deep emotion.

units.source_text: 一离开对局场地，他如释重负，行走起来时，

en.t: Once he had left the match room, as he began to walk with the air of having laid down a heavy burden,

units.source_text: 背影显出现今社会看不到的一种平静，令人感到如同明治时代的遗老。

en.t: his figure from behind revealed a kind of calm no longer seen in modern society, making him seem like a venerable survivor of the Meiji era.
